overview: Boucherville had 41,743 residents in the 2021 Census, almost unchanged from 41,671 in 2016, living in 17,291 occupied dwellings across 71.02 square kilometres. It is a mature suburb where growth comes from turnover in existing homes rather than new subdivisions.

Its industrial park is one of the largest in Quebec and brings in far more workers each day than the city has households. That gives local businesses two markets: settled resident families and a large daytime business population needing services, supplies and meals.
